musepi.label: Hot reload
musepi.description: Host-scope watcher that provides ctx.hmr for every host.

config.label: Watch base
config.description: Base directory for relative root entries. Defaults to the host process cwd.

config.label: Watch roots
config.description: Comma-separated roots, resolved against base. Empty keeps the native extension/plugin roots.

config.label: Ignored globs
config.description: Comma-separated globs excluded on top of .git and the module cache.

config.label: Debounce (ms)
config.description: How long file changes are coalesced before one reload batch is emitted.
